verdict.rationale: Antigravity has a dedicated MCP docs page saying MCP lets it fetch context and run actions against local tools, databases and remote APIs. The CLI exposes MCP configuration through slash commands, plugins can bundle MCP servers, and the Agent SDK can layer MCP servers over its built-in tools. This shows first-party MCP client support across the desktop app, CLI and SDK. Missing for 10: concrete configuration and transport details (e.g., config file format, stdio/remote server setup) in the evidence, and independent hands-on corroboration of plugging in MCP servers.
